brief.goal: Banner cho sự kiện Nghiên Connect #4 của Nghiên AI với chủ đề Vibe Coding cho người mới bắt đầu. Chuẩn phong cách thiết kế MoMo, kết hợp logo Nghiên AI, không dùng logo MoMo. 3 phương án tư vấn đa dạng layout, theme và góc tiếp cận.
brief.audience: Người mới bắt đầu, non-coders, marketers, designers, product managers, sinh viên muốn tự build app/web bằng AI

image.scene: a young cheerful Vietnamese person wearing glasses and headphones sitting comfortably with laptop and iced coffee at a modern desk, colorful glowing UI cards and friendly code blocks floating smoothly in the air
image.prompt:
Keep EXACTLY the drawing style, line color, halftone shading, engraving lines and palette of the reference illustrations. Even medium ink outlines in #1F4FA8 (never black); flat pastel fills (peach #F59A7A / #FFEFE6 with blue #1F4FA8 accents); shadows ONLY as halftone dots and parallel hatching; background with fine wavy parallel engraving lines like a banknote; maximum 3 hues; young Vietnamese people, realistic proportions, casual clothes, cheerful.
Create a NEW illustration, aspect ratio 3:2: a young cheerful Vietnamese person wearing glasses and headphones sitting comfortably with laptop and iced coffee at a modern desk, colorful glowing UI cards and friendly code blocks floating smoothly in the air.
Clean rectangle. Main subjects center-right; top-left and bottom-left corners calm and empty (they will be cropped by the layout frame; the bottom-left holds the logo).
FORBIDDEN: 3D, render, clay, glossy, gradients, glow, soft drop shadows, black outlines, anime/chibi, neon, more than 3 hues, plain white background, any text/letters/numbers/logos/QR, frames, borders, pink 'mo mo' strips, the MoMo mascot.
